description: Metodyka Badań i Wyniki Testu tylnego zawieszenie w małym elektrycznym samochodzie dostawczym is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Anglo-Pol Newson&Kudaj sp. j. The aim of the research was to design and manufacture a chassis for a small delivery van in the M1 class. The rear suspension of the car was made on the principle of a trailing arm with the possibility of turning up to 2.6 degrees when cornering. Coverage: Anglo-Pol Newson&Kudaj sp. j. The portal shows the English title as "Research - methodology and results of the rear suspension test" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Anglo-Pol Newson&Kudaj sp. j. Its keywords include Samochód elektryczny. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ODS. The listing shows 2024-11-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
